items.markdown:
Finding the right lip balm depends on whether you need heavy-duty repair, daily hydration, or daytime sun protection . Dermatologists generally recommend looking for **occlusives** (like petrolatum, shea butter, or ceramides) to seal in moisture and **humectants** (like glycerin or hyaluronic acid) to draw it in, while avoiding irritants like menthol, camphor, and heavy fragrances.[[1]](https://www.riverchasedermatology.com/blog/13-best-lip-balms-for-dry-lips-according-to-a-dermatologist/)

### Top Picks by Category

- **Best Overall / Heavy-Duty Repair:** **[Aquaphor Lip Repair](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462472714339173,imageDocid:5087476633351567825,gpcid:4156687742650633637,headlineOfferDocid:7122147428139866059,catalogid:5349653040222313434,productDocid:2477652689659706858,rds:PC_4156687742650633637%7CPROD_PC_4156687742650633637&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi8iNaj64OYAxWohv0HHZ-ACq4Qxa4PeggIAggBCBcQAw)** 
	- *Why it works:* A classic dermatologist favorite that uses panthenol, shea butter, and glycerin to instantly soothe and rebuild cracked skin without a stinging sensation.
	- *Where to find:* Check options on Health.com.[[1]](https://www.riverchasedermatology.com/blog/13-best-lip-balms-for-dry-lips-according-to-a-dermatologist/)
- **Best Budget / Pure Occlusive:** **[Vaseline Lip Therapy (Original or Rosy Lips)](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:8292350759824174571,gpcid:6554030729008155360,headlineOfferDocid:13030854972933038936,catalogid:13530901084781159148,productDocid:6639997086322483950,rds:PC_9415752064491732561%7CPROD_PC_9415752064491732561&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi8iNaj64OYAxWohv0HHZ-ACq4Qxa4PeggIAggBCBcQDA)** 
	- *Why it works:* Simple, pure petroleum jelly is unmatched at locking in moisture overnight and protecting compromised lip barriers.[[1]](https://www.riverchasedermatology.com/blog/13-best-lip-balms-for-dry-lips-according-to-a-dermatologist/)
- **Best for Sensitive or Chapped Lips:** **[La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Lips B5](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462568015882166,imageDocid:14121570211342841237,gpcid:11578366188543385976,headlineOfferDocid:4608675855795316289,catalogid:4419840257675721086,productDocid:14523635329048285613,rds:PC_11578366188543385976%7CPROD_PC_11578366188543385976&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi8iNaj64OYAxWohv0HHZ-ACq4Qxa4PeggIAggBCBcQFA)** 
	- *Why it works:* Formulated with panthenol and MP-lipids to actively repair and comfort very dry, irritated, or flaky lips.
- **Best Daily Splurge / Hydration Glow:** **[Laneige Lip Glowy Balm](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:15304927709447929358,gpcid:8663950540879331494,headlineOfferDocid:10686820673757290618,catalogid:6311070506198773714,productDocid:6566034023326052986,rds:PC_1452637533679338749%7CPROD_PC_1452637533679338749&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi8iNaj64OYAxWohv0HHZ-ACq4Qxa4PeggIAggBCBcQGg)** (or *[Ole Henriksen Pout Preserve Peptide Lip Treatment](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462731931924897,imageDocid:16916798385465000065,gpcid:6438328943358196398,headlineOfferDocid:16263798502408359076,catalogid:16985374127602986369,productDocid:6093364460899009164,rds:PC_6438328943358196398%7CPROD_PC_6438328943358196398&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi8iNaj64OYAxWohv0HHZ-ACq4Qxa4PeggIAggBCBcQGw) *)
	- *Why it works:* Gives a pillowy, glossy finish while deeply conditioning the lips with cupuaçu butter and peptides.
- **Best with SPF (Daytime):** **[EltaMD UV Lip Balm Broad-Spectrum SPF 36](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:13932786399369319150,gpcid:4239484056023188550,headlineOfferDocid:10665186867236109685,catalogid:6856937823317156176,productDocid:10895727798997842314,rds:PC_10441999084354243581%7CPROD_PC_10441999084354243581&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi8iNaj64OYAxWohv0HHZ-ACq4Qxa4PeggIAggBCBcQIQ)** (or *[Coola Mineral Liplux SPF 30](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462897726229966,imageDocid:7735153651518145389,gpcid:1917900084294158712,headlineOfferDocid:9078969007742925247,catalogid:10811489898600748635,productDocid:12869412708648815876,rds:PC_1917900084294158712%7CPROD_PC_1917900084294158712&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi8iNaj64OYAxWohv0HHZ-ACq4Qxa4PeggIAggBCBcQIg) *)
	- *Why it works:* Protects delicate lip tissue from UV damage, which is a leading and often-overlooked cause of chronically dry, peeling lips.[[1]](https://www.riverchasedermatology.com/blog/13-best-lip-balms-for-dry-lips-according-to-a-dermatologist/)
- **Best for Stubborn, Cracked Cheilitis:** **[Dr. Dan’s CortiBalm](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462801166044233,imageDocid:486441255367338479,gpcid:12355685311896226422,headlineOfferDocid:4649976223732538675,catalogid:14849832491738234323,productDocid:12421337285521279770,rds:PC_1959454081319225663%7CPROD_PC_1959454081319225663&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi8iNaj64OYAxWohv0HHZ-ACq4Qxa4PeggIAggBCBcQKg)** 
	- *Why it works:* Contains 1% hydrocortisone alongside beeswax and petroleum; ideal for severely chapped or allergic-reaction lips that won't heal with regular balms (use short-term).[[1]](https://www.riverchasedermatology.com/blog/13-best-lip-balms-for-dry-lips-according-to-a-dermatologist/)

### Quick Shopping & Care Tips

1. **Ditch the tingle:** If a lip balm feels "minty" or cooling (menthol, camphor, phenol), it is often drying your lips out further in the long run.[[1]](https://www.riverchasedermatology.com/blog/13-best-lip-balms-for-dry-lips-according-to-a-dermatologist/)
2. **Night vs. Day:** Use a simple ointment like *Aquaphor* or *[Vaseline](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462916260973666,imageDocid:13116542962736411036,gpcid:11405394871354187233,headlineOfferDocid:6031165616241937464,catalogid:2573181380051873158,productDocid:3949552184748464110,rds:PC_6016358279956362637%7CPROD_PC_6016358279956362637&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi8iNaj64OYAxWohv0HHZ-ACq4Qxa4PeggIAggBCB8QBw) * right before bed, and switch to an SPF-infused formula during daylight hours.[[1]](https://www.riverchasedermatology.com/blog/13-best-lip-balms-for-dry-lips-according-to-a-dermatologist/)
3. **Check hydration:** Chronic dry lips can also stem from overall systemic dehydration or mouth-breathing at night.[[1]](https://www.riverchasedermatology.com/blog/13-best-lip-balms-for-dry-lips-according-to-a-dermatologist/)
